/-! ## Accesses to leaves (§12, §15, §16) -/

/-- Address of the range of place `l` in `s2`: the base of its allocation plus its offset (§12 ¶1,
§82.1). -/
def leafAddr (s2 : Machine.State) (L : Layout) (l : Nat) : Nat := baseOf s2 (L l).alloc + (L l).off

/-- The means of access to the range of leaf `l` in `s2` (§12 ¶1, §82.2): address of the range,
provenance its allocation, length its size, elementary authority `au`. -/
def leafAcc (s2 : Machine.State) (L : Layout) (au : Machine.Auth) (l : Nat) : Machine.Access :=
  ⟨leafAddr s2 L l, (L l).alloc, (L l).len, au⟩

/-- The access to a leaf of a registered allocation (§12 ¶1). -/
theorem leafAcc_of {s2 : Machine.State} {L : Layout} {au : Machine.Auth} {l : Nat}
    {a : Machine.Alloc} (h : s2.allocs (L l).alloc = some a) :
    leafAcc s2 L au l = ⟨a.base + (L l).off, (L l).alloc, (L l).len, au⟩ := by
  simp [leafAcc, leafAddr, baseOf_of h]

/-- The access to a leaf is kept by `Dom` when its allocation is registered (§13 ¶3). -/
theorem leafAcc_dom {s2 s2' : Machine.State} (hd : Dom s2 s2') {L : Layout} {au : Machine.Auth}
    {l : Nat} (h : AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun _ => True) :
    leafAcc s2' L au l = leafAcc s2 L au l := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, -⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨a', ha', e, -⟩ := hd _ a ha
  rw [leafAcc_of ha, leafAcc_of ha', e]

/-- The kernel read conditions of the access to a leaf whose allocation is live, contains the
range and has it initialized (§15.1, §15.2, §15.3, §15.5). -/
theorem canRead_leaf {s2 : Machine.State} {L : Layout} {l : Nat} {a : Machine.Alloc}
    (ha : s2.allocs (L l).alloc = some a) (hl : a.live = true)
    (hs : (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size) (hi : a.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len) :
    Machine.CanRead s2 (leafAcc s2 L .read l) := by
  rw [leafAcc_of ha]
  refine ⟨a, ha, hl, ⟨Nat.le_add_right _ _, by simp only; omega⟩, ?_, .inl rfl⟩
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]; exact hi

/-- The kernel write conditions of the access to a leaf whose allocation is live and contains the
range (§16.1, §16.2, §16.3). -/
theorem canWrite_leaf {s2 : Machine.State} {L : Layout} {l : Nat} {a : Machine.Alloc}
    (ha : s2.allocs (L l).alloc = some a) (hl : a.live = true)
    (hs : (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size) : Machine.CanWrite s2 (leafAcc s2 L .write l) := by
  rw [leafAcc_of ha]
  exact ⟨a, ha, hl, ⟨Nat.le_add_right _ _, by simp only; omega⟩, .inr rfl⟩

/-- After the write of the range of a leaf of a registered allocation, the range is initialized
(§16 ¶2). -/
theorem write_leaf_init {s2 : Machine.State} {L : Layout} {l : Nat}
    {w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} (h : AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun _ => True) :
    AllocP (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) w) (L l).alloc
      fun a => a.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, -⟩ := h
  refine ⟨a.write (L l).off (L l).len w, ?_, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  · rw [write_allocs, leafAcc_of ha]
    simp only [↓reduceIte, ha, Option.map_some, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  · rw [Machine.Alloc.write_bytes_in a w hi]; exact fun h => by cases h

/-! ## Leaves of usable places -/

/-- A leaf of a usable place has a usable root place (§40, §49.2). -/
theorem root_of_leaf {s3 : S3} (hw : WF3 s3) {l : Nat} (hl : l < s3.P.length)
    (hu : s3.Usable l) : ∃ r, RootPlace s3.P r ∧ partOf s3.P l r ∧ s3.Usable r := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hlr⟩ := exists_rootPlace hw (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hl
  exact ⟨r, hr, hlr, usable_of_part hw hlr hu⟩

/-- A leaf that belongs to a usable place is an existing usable leaf (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1,
§40). -/
theorem leaf_of_leafOfUsable {s3 : S3} (hw : WF3 s3) {l : Nat} (h : LeafOfUsable s3 l) :
    l < s3.P.length ∧ isLeaf s3.P l ∧ s3.Usable l := by
  obtain ⟨q, -, hq, hl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hlP, hlf, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
  exact ⟨hlP, hlf, usable_of_partOf hw (l + 1) l q (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hlq hq⟩

/-- The allocation of a usable leaf is live and contains its range (§82.5, §82.1). -/
theorem Repr.leaf_live {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State}
    (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3) {l : Nat} (hl : l < s3.P.length)
    (hlf : isLeaf s3.P l) (hu : s3.Usable l) :
    AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => a.live = true ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hlr, hur⟩ := root_of_leaf hw hl hu
  have hlive := hR.live r hr hur
  rw [← hR.layout.alloc_part hlr] at hlive
  exact hlive.and (hR.layout.within l hl hlf)

/-! ## R1: safe reads (§82.2, §66, §15) -/

/-- The reads realizing `read(access, ls)` (§82.2, §66): one raw read per leaf, of the range of
the leaf, at the type `ty l` of the leaf. -/
def readOps {Ty : Type} (s2 : Machine.State) (L : Layout) (ty : Nat → Ty) (ls : List Nat) :
    List (Machine.Op Ty) :=
  ls.map fun l => .read (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l)

/-- Safe read (§82.2, §66, §15): under `Repr`, `WF3` and the preconditions of `read` (§66), the
raw read of the range of each leaf read is `ok` when the parametric obligations of that read hold
(§15.4, §15.6, §15.7): its allocation is live, the range is initialized, and the read returns the
bytes of the range. -/
theorem r1_read {Ty : Type} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ty : Nat → Ty} {L : Layout}
    {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat}
    (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3) (hpre : Read3Pre s3 a ls) {l : Nat} (hl : l ∈ ls)
    (hob : ObR.dec s2 (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l) ∧ ObR.stat s2 (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l)) :
    ∃ al, s2.allocs (L l).alloc = some al ∧ al.live = true ∧ al.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len ∧
      Machine.ReadStep ObR (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l) s2
        (.ok (al.bytesAt (L l).off (L l).len)) := by
  obtain ⟨hlP, hlf, hu⟩ := leaf_of_leafOfUsable hw (hpre.usable l hl)
  obtain ⟨al, hal, hlive, hsz⟩ := hR.leaf_live hw hlP hlf hu
  obtain ⟨al', hal', hi⟩ := hR.init l hlP hlf (hpre.init l hl)
  rw [hal] at hal'; cases hal'
  refine ⟨al, hal, hlive, hi, ?_⟩
  have hc := canRead_leaf hal hlive hsz hi
  have hst := Machine.ReadStep.ok (ObR := ObR) (t := ty l) hal ⟨hc, hob.1, hob.2⟩
  rw [leafAcc_of hal] at hst ⊢
  simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using hst

/-- The reads of a sequence of leaves leave the memory state unchanged (§20.2 ¶1). -/
theorem run_readOps {Ty : Type} (s2 : Machine.State) (L : Layout) (ty : Nat → Ty) :
    ∀ ls t, run t (readOps s2 L ty ls) = t
  | [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: ls, t => run_readOps s2 L ty ls t

/-- Realization of `read` (§82 preamble, §82.2, §66): under `Repr`, `WF3`, an `ok` step of `read`
and the parametric obligations along the reads, the reads form an execution of `ok` raw steps
that leaves the memory state unchanged, and `Repr` holds after the step. -/
theorem r6_read {Ty : Type} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {ty : Nat → Ty} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat}
    {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2)
    (hw : WF3 s3) (h : Read3Step a ls s3 (.ok s3'))
    (hob : OblAlong ObR ObW s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls)) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (readOps s2 L ty ls) s2 (run s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls)) ∧
      run s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls) = s2 ∧ Repr L rtok s3' (run s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls)) := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  rw [run_readOps]
  refine ⟨?_, rfl, hR⟩
  have key : ∀ ls', (∀ l ∈ ls', l ∈ ls) → OblAlong ObR ObW s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls') →
      Along (OkAt C ObR ObW) s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls') := by
    intro ls'
    induction ls' with
    | nil => intro _ _; trivial
    | cons l ls' ih =>
      intro hsub hob'
      obtain ⟨al, hal, -, -, hst⟩ := r1_read hR hw hpre (hsub l (List.mem_cons_self ..)) hob'.1
      exact ⟨.read hst, ih (fun l' hl' => hsub l' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hl')) hob'.2⟩
  have := exec_of_along _ _ (key ls (fun _ h => h) hob)
  rwa [run_readOps] at this

/-- Authority (§42): own mode, optional origin, footprint (a list of leaves read
extensionally), holder, activity. Its identity is its index in `A`. -/
structure Authority where
  mode : Mode
  origin : Option Nat
  footprint : List Nat
  holder : Holder
  active : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State `S3` (§38). `F`, `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` are the components of §38. `nF` (next fresh frame
identity, §39), `dead` (death marker of places, §40) and `pin` (dynamic pinning of leaves, §74)
are auxiliary information that creates no right (§38). -/
structure S3 where
  F : Frames
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  pin : Nat → Bool

/-- Shape of the locals of `enterFrame` (§72) and of an allocation (§71.1): each element is an
optional structural parent (a place index) and a `kind`. Every element is owned by the holder
receiving the shape. -/
abbrev LocalShape := List (Option Nat × Nat)

/-- External contract `K` (§48, §80): `DeclaredDisjoint` on regions (§23, §61.3);
`SharedMutable` and `Pinned` on leaves (§68.1, §63.5); `ExternalDone` and `Deallocable` on places
(§75, §70.2); `FreeCompat place auth` (§70.2); `Satisfiable provider shape s` (§71). Obligations of
`K` are hypotheses of theorems, never fields. -/
structure K where
  DeclaredDisjoint : List Nat → List Nat → Prop
  SharedMutable : Nat → Prop
  Pinned : Nat → Prop
  ExternalDone : Nat → Prop
  Deallocable : Nat → Prop
  FreeCompat : Nat → Nat → Prop
  Satisfiable : Nat → LocalShape → S3 → Prop
      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)

/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/

/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)

/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47; not stated by §47, a hypothesis of the theorems on the
initial state): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's
owning static. -/
def StaticsOK (statics : Statics) : Prop := ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))

/-- Decidability of `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
instance (statics : Statics) : Decidable (StaticsOK statics) := by
  unfold StaticsOK; infer_instance

/-- `S3.init statics` (§47): base frame 0 and the declared statics, owned by frame 0 or by
another static; one root `Modify` authority with no origin per root static, held by its owner;
leaves `Init` or `Uninit` as declared; no anchor, no derived authority, nothing dead or
pinned. -/
def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
  { F := [0]
    nF := 1
    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩
    D := fun _ => []
    dead := fun _ => false
    pin := fun _ => false }

/-- `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75, §80): every static place whose leaf is designated by `K.Pinned` is
directly owned by the base frame 0. A condition on `(K, statics)`. -/
def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop :=
  ∀ l < statics.length, k.Pinned l →
    OptP ((S3.init statics).P[l]?) (fun pl => pl.owner = .frame 0) False

/-! ## Reachability (§57) -/

/-- States reachable from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). -/
inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
  | init : Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
  | step {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → KStep k s s' → Reachable k statics s'

/-! ## Non-vacuity examples (§47, §60–§75)

Each operation has an accepting state, decided by `decide` on concrete states built from
`S3.init`; a few rejections are included. -/

namespace Examples

/-- Test contract (§48): nothing declared disjoint or pinned, every leaf `SharedMutable`, every
external use done, every place deallocable, every request satisfiable. -/
def K0 : K := ⟨fun _ _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => True,
  fun _ _ => True, fun _ _ _ => True⟩

/-- Decidability of `K0.DeclaredDisjoint` (§48). -/
instance : ∀ r r', Decidable (K0.DeclaredDisjoint r r') :=
  fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
/-- Decidability of `K0.SharedMutable` (§48). -/
instance : DecidablePred K0.SharedMutable := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
/-- Decidability of `K0.Pinned` (§48). -/
instance : DecidablePred K0.Pinned := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
/-- Decidability of `K0.ExternalDone` (§48). -/
instance : DecidablePred K0.ExternalDone := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
/-- Decidability of `K0.Deallocable` (§48). -/
instance : DecidablePred K0.Deallocable := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
/-- Decidability of `K0.FreeCompat` (§48). -/
instance : ∀ p a, Decidable (K0.FreeCompat p a) := fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

/-! ## Shapes (§47, §71.1, §72) -/

/-- A local shape as a shape whose elements have no owning element (§71.1, §72: locals and
allocated storage are owned by the receiving holder). -/
def LocalShape.toShape (ls : LocalShape) : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) :=
  ls.map fun e => (e.1, none, e.2)

/-- Owner of element `i` of a shape (§47, §72, §71): its owning element if any, `hd`
otherwise. -/
def shapeOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (hd : Holder) (i : Nat) : Holder :=
  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
  | some o => .place o
  | none => hd

  unfold LeafOfUsable; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `read` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§66). The type and storage
contract of §66.3 is not represented. -/
structure Read3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §66.1: every leaf read belongs to a usable place. -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §66.1: every leaf read is `Init`. -/
  init : ∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init
  /-- §66.2: `access` is exercisable in `Observe`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .observe
  /-- §66.2: the effective mode of `access` permits observation of each leaf. -/
  effectivePresent : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none
  /-- §66.3: required anchors are valid. -/
  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l

  | .place _ => true
  | .frame _ => false

/-- `OwnedRoot` (§70.1): a place with no structural parent, owned by a place. -/
def OwnedRoot (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.P[p]?) (fun pl => pl.parent = none ∧ pl.owner.isPlace = true) False

/-- Decidability of `OwnedRoot` (§70.1). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (OwnedRoot s p) := by
  unfold OwnedRoot; infer_instance

theorem kexp_path {k : K} {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState} (h : LOpStep k lop L L') :
    KPath k L.kern (kexp lop L) L'.kern := by
  cases lop with
  | kernel op => exact .cons h.1 (.nil _)
  | newArena others st i =>
    rw [newArena_kernel (show NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L') from h)]
    exact .nil _
  | issue i region dst =>
    have h' : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L') := h
    cases h' with
    | ok hE _ _ hsp hst =>
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp
      simp only [kexp, hE]
      exact .cons hsp (.cons hst (.nil _))
  | reset i =>
    have h' : ResetD i L (.ok L') := h
    cases h' with
    | ok hE hd hrl _ =>
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd
      simp only [kexp, hE]
      exact .cons hd (.cons hrl (.nil _))

/-- The steps of a kernel sequence keep the authorities of its first state (§42, §58), and each
is an `ok` step from the state listed with it. -/
theorem KPath.mem {k : K} {s s' : S3} {t : List (KOp × S3)} (hp : KPath k s t s') :
    ∀ q ∈ t, AKeep s q.2 ∧ ∃ s₁, OpStep k q.1 q.2 s₁ := by
  induction hp with
  | nil => intro q hq; cases hq
  | cons h _ ih =>
    intro q hq
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hq with rfl | hq
    · exact ⟨akeep_of_eq rfl, _, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := ih q hq
      exact ⟨(kstep_akeep h.kstep).trans hk, hs⟩

/-- The kernel steps of a library step start from states satisfying `WF3` and `NoDangling` when
the library state does (§49, §54): the states after `split` and after `derive` keep both
(§60, §61). -/
theorem kexp_inv {k : K} {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState} (h : LOpStep k lop L L') (hw : WF3 L.kern)
    (hnd : NoDangling L.kern) : ∀ q ∈ kexp lop L, WF3 q.2 ∧ NoDangling q.2 := by
  cases lop with
  | kernel op =>
    intro q hq
    rw [kexp, List.mem_singleton] at hq
    subst hq
    exact ⟨hw, hnd⟩
  | newArena => intro q hq; cases hq
  | issue i region dst =>

/-- Realization of a kernel sequence (§82 preamble, R6 of each step): from states satisfying
`WF3` and `NoDangling`, under the obligations of each step, the raw operations of the sequence
form an execution of `ok` raw steps and `Repr` holds after it. -/
theorem r6_path {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} (hπ : ParamsOK C π) {s3 s3' : S3}
    {t : List (KOp × S3)} (hp : KPath k s3 t s3') :
    ∀ {s2 : Machine.State}, (∀ q ∈ t, WF3 q.2 ∧ NoDangling q.2) → KObl k C ObR ObW π t s2 →
      Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2 →
      Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (ktrace π t s2) s2 (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) ∧
        Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok s3' (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) := by
  induction hp with
  | nil => intro s2 _ _ hR; exact ⟨.nil _, hR⟩
  | cons h _ ih =>
    intro s2 hinv hob hR
    obtain ⟨hw, hnd⟩ := hinv _ (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    obtain ⟨hob₁, hob₂⟩ := hob
    obtain ⟨hex, hR₁⟩ := r6 hπ hR hw hnd h hob₁
    obtain ⟨hex', hR'⟩ := ih (fun q hq => hinv q (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq)) hob₂ hR₁
    simp only [ktrace]
    rw [run_append]
    exact ⟨exec_append hex hex', hR'⟩

/-- Realization of a library step (§82.7, §82 preamble): from a library state whose kernel
state satisfies `WF3` and `NoDangling`, under the obligations of its kernel steps, the raw
operations of an `ok` library step form an execution of `ok` raw steps and `Repr` holds after
it. -/
theorem lr6 {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (hπ : ParamsOK C π) (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2)
    (hw : WF3 L.kern) (hnd : NoDangling L.kern) (h : LOpStep k lop L L')
    (hob : KObl k C ObR ObW π (kexp lop L) s2) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (lopsOf π lop L s2) s2 (run s2 (lopsOf π lop L s2)) ∧
      Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L'.kern (run s2 (lopsOf π lop L s2)) :=
  r6_path hπ (kexp_path h) (kexp_inv h hw hnd) hob hR

/-! ## R4 transported by the derived operations (§82.5, §54) -/

/-- The conclusion of R4 (`r4_no_dead_cover`, §82.5, §54): every leaf covered by an active
authority of `s3` is an existing leaf whose allocation in `s2` is live and contains its range. -/
def LiveCover (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s3.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true → ∀ l ∈ y.footprint,
    l < s3.P.length ∧ isLeaf s3.P l ∧
      AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => a.live = true ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size

/-- R4 (§82.5, §54): `Repr`, `WF3` and `NoDangling` give `LiveCover` (`r4_no_dead_cover`). -/
theorem liveCover_of {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State}
    (hR : Refinement.Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3) (hnd : NoDangling s3) :
    LiveCover L s3 s2 :=
  fun _ _ hy ya _ hl => r4_no_dead_cover hR hw hnd hy ya hl

/-- A live allocation containing a range stays so along raw operations without deallocation
(§13 ¶3, §16 ¶3). -/
theorem liveWithin_run {Ty : Type} {s2 : Machine.State} (hwf : Machine.WF s2)
    {os : List (Machine.Op Ty)} (hn : ∀ o ∈ os, NoDealloc o) {i off len : Nat}
    (h : AllocP s2 i fun a => a.live = true ∧ off + len ≤ a.size) :
    AllocP (run s2 os) i fun a => a.live = true ∧ off + len ≤ a.size := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hl, hsz⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨a', ha', hl'⟩ := live_run os s2 hwf hn ⟨a, ha, hl⟩
  obtain ⟨a'', ha'', -, e, -⟩ := dom_run os s2 hwf i a ha
  rw [ha'] at ha''
  cases ha''
  exact ⟨a', ha', hl', by rw [e]; exact hsz⟩

  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable storage ∧ HasRight s .modify storage ∧

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` (§76): those of `NewArenaBase` and the guard of
§76.4 over the arena registry and the other registries `others` (§56). -/
structure NewArenaPre (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat))
    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1–§76.3, §76.5. -/
  base : NewArenaBase s storage internal
  /-- §76.4, §56: no live administration of any relevant registry uses `internal`. -/
  guard : Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal

/-- Decidability of `NewArenaPre` (§76). -/
instance (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
    Decidable (NewArenaPre s arenas others storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
    Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `newArena` (§76, `ok` effect): a live entry is added, `available` holding the leaves
of the storage and `issued` empty; the kernel state is unchanged. -/
def newArenaEff (L : LState) (storage internal : Nat) : LState :=
  { L with arenas := L.arenas ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint L.kern.P storage, []⟩] }

/-- `newArena` as a relation (§76, §58): `ok` or `reject`; `others` are the other registries of
live administrations consulted by the guard (§56). -/
def NewArenaStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (L : LState) :
    Outcome3 LState → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewArenaPre L.kern L.arenas others storage internal) (newArenaEff L storage internal)

import Ern.Corpus.Runner
import Ern.MemoryModel.RefinementArena

/-!
# Corpus MM23-H: refinement (test module)

The cases of corpus MM23-H of the Jalon 3 material (`ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md`, §3; non-normative
design material), replayed on the reference refinement of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md` (§82, Part XIV). This is a test module: no model or
library module imports it.

Each case is a run from the initial state (§47) translated into the elementary memory machine with
the contract, the deallocation compatibility (equality of tokens), the read and write obligations
and the parameters fixed once for the run (§20.3 ¶3, §82): the test layout `piOf` of
`Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement.Runs` (each root place in its own allocation, each leaf 8 bytes at 8
times its rank, `LayoutWF` established by `Repr`), the placement `topPlacement`, the tokens
`100 + r`, the 8-byte reference encoding `pe8`. Runs of kernel operations only are kernel
simulation runs (`SimRun`, built by `srun`, conclusions by `simulation`); runs with an arena are
library simulation runs (`LSimRun`, built by the runner `lsrun` below, conclusions by
`lsimulation`), in which `issue` is the derived library operation (`split` then `store`) and
`reset` the derived reset (`derive` then `release`). The reached states are those of these runs
(material §0, rule 3). The obtained result is stated with the kernel relation of the step under
test, the machine relations of its realized raw operations (`ReadStep`, `WriteStep`,
`DeallocStep`, `Exec`) and the bytes read back, all decided by `decide`.

Each docstring gives the expected verdict of the material, the obtained one, the class (material
§0, rule 5: `R` refinement) and the positive twin of each rejection or `fail` (rule 2). A case
whose obtained verdict differs from its expected one, or whose expected verdict has no spec v0
source, is kept with its expected verdict and classified; no case is corrected.

(§82 preamble; `srun`); the initial states when a step is not `ok`. -/

  (srun k (· = ·) obR obW π (sinit statics π) ops).getD (sinit statics π)

kernel operation whose preconditions hold, registry unchanged; the effect of `newArena` under its
preconditions (§76); the `ok` state of the derived `issue` and `reset` computed by the corpus
runner (§77, §78). `none` otherwise. -/

  | .kernel op => if OpPre k op L.kern then some ⟨opEff3 op L.kern, L.arenas⟩ else none
  | .newArena others st i =>
    if NewArenaPre L.kern L.arenas others st i then some (newArenaEff L st i) else none
  | .issue i r d =>
    match lstep k L (.issue i r d) with
    | .ok L' => some L'
    | _ => none
  | .reset i =>
    match lstep k L (.reset i) with
    | .ok L' => some L'
    | _ => none

variable (π : Params Unit)

the kernel state (§49, §54), the library operation is `ok` and the obligations of its kernel steps
hold, the next library state and the memory state after the raw operations of its kernel
steps. -/

  match lnext k st.1 lop with
  | some L' =>

    else none
  | none => none

  | st, [] => some st
  | st, lop :: lops => (lsstep k π st lop).bind fun st' => lsrun st' lops

`LSimRun.init`). -/

states when a step is not `ok`. -/

    [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
    [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
    (statics : Statics) (π : Params Unit) (lops : List LOp) : LState × Machine.State :=
  (lsrun k π (linit statics π) lops).getD (linit statics π)

  | .kernel op => some op
  | _ => none

(§82): `newArena`, `issue` and `reset` create no place (§76–§78). The layout parameter is fixed
once from them. -/

  (kernelRun (S3.init statics) (lops.filterMap kernelOf)).P

section Sound

variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- A computed next library state is the `ok` step of the library operation (Part XIV, §58,

theorem lnext_sound {L L' : LState} {lop : LOp} (h : lnext k L lop = some L') :
    LOpStep k lop L L' := by
  cases lop with
  | kernel op =>
    simp only [lnext] at h
    split at h
    · next hp => cases h; exact ⟨opStep_of_pre hp, rfl⟩
    · cases h
  | newArena others st i =>
    simp only [lnext] at h
    split at h
    · next hp => cases h; exact .ok hp
    · cases h
  | issue i r d =>
    have hs := lstep_sound (k := k) L (.issue i r d)
    simp only [lnext] at h
    split at h
    · next L₁ he => cases h; rw [he] at hs; exact hs
    · cases h
  | reset i =>
    have hs := lstep_sound (k := k) L (.reset i)
    simp only [lnext] at h
    split at h
    · next L₁ he => cases h; rw [he] at hs; exact hs
    · cases h

/-- A successful translated library run extends a library simulation run (§82.7). -/
theorem lsrun_sound {statics : Statics} {π : Params Unit} :
    ∀ (lops : List LOp) (st st' : LState × Machine.State),
      LSimRun k (· = ·) obR obW statics π st.1 st.2 → lsrun k π st lops = some st' →
      LSimRun k (· = ·) obR obW statics π st'.1 st'.2
  | [], st, st', h, he => by
    simp only [lsrun, Option.some.injEq] at he; subst he; exact h
  | lop :: lops, st, st', h, he => by
    simp only [lsrun] at he
    cases hs : lsstep k π st lop with
    | none => rw [hs] at he; cases he
    | some st₁ =>
      rw [hs] at he
      simp only [Option.bind_some] at he
      unfold lsstep at hs
      split at hs
      · next L' hn =>
        split at hs
        · next hc =>
          simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hs; subst hs
          exact lsrun_sound lops _ st' (.step h (wf3_of_check hc.1) (noDangling_of_check hc.2.1)
            (lnext_sound hn) hc.2.2) he
        · cases hs
      · cases hs

preamble). -/
theorem ksim {statics : Statics} {π : Params Unit} {ops : List KOp} (hi : InitOK statics π)
    (h : (srun k (· = ·) obR obW π (sinit statics π) ops).isSome = true) :
    SimRun k (· = ·) obR obW statics π (kfin k statics π ops).1 (kfin k statics π ops).2 :=
  srun_sound ops (sinit statics π) _ (.init hi.1 hi.2.1 hi.2.2) (some_getD _ h)

/-- A successful translated library run from `LState.init statics` is a library simulation run
(§82.7). -/
theorem lsim {statics : Statics} {π : Params Unit} {lops : List LOp} (hi : InitOK statics π)
    (h : (lsrun k π (linit statics π) lops).isSome = true) :
    LSimRun k (· = ·) obR obW statics π (lfin k statics π lops).1 (lfin k statics π lops).2 :=
  lsrun_sound lops (linit statics π) _ (.init hi.1 hi.2.1 hi.2.2) (some_getD _ h)

/-- The raw operations realizing a kernel step from a state of a kernel simulation run are an
execution of `ok` raw steps (§82 preamble, `r6`), when the bounded invariant checks (§49, §54),
the preconditions of the step and its obligations hold. -/
theorem kexec {statics : Statics} {π : Params Unit} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {op : KOp}
    (hπ : ParamsOK (· = ·) π) (h : SimRun k (· = ·) obR obW statics π s3 s2)
    (hc : WF3Check s3 ∧ NoDanglingCheck s3 ∧ OpPre k op s3 ∧
      StepObl k (· = ·) obR obW π op s3 s2) :
    Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW (opsOf π op s3 s2) s2 (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) :=
  (r6 hπ (simulation hπ h).2.1 (wf3_of_check hc.1) (noDangling_of_check hc.2.1)
    (opStep_of_pre hc.2.2.1) hc.2.2.2).1

end Sound

/-! ## Raw operations and bytes read back (§9, §15–§17, §20) -/

/-- The allocation a raw operation reads, writes or deallocates (§15, §16, §17); none for a
creation. -/
def opAlloc {Ty : Type} : Machine.Op Ty → Option Nat
  | .read ac _ => some ac.prov
  | .write ac _ _ => some ac.prov
  | .dealloc i _ => some i
  | .alloc .. => none

/-- The kind of a raw operation (§20.1): 0 read, 1 write, 2 deallocation, 3 creation. -/
def opKind {Ty : Type} : Machine.Op Ty → Nat
  | .read .. => 0
  | .write .. => 1
  | .dealloc .. => 2
  | .alloc .. => 3

/-- The size of a raw creation (§9 ¶1, §9 ¶11). -/
def opSize {Ty : Type} : Machine.Op Ty → Option Nat
  | .alloc _ _ size _ _ => some size
  | _ => none

/-- The allocation and presented authority of a raw deallocation (§17). -/
def opDealloc {Ty : Type} : Machine.Op Ty → Option (Nat × Nat)
  | .dealloc i auth => some (i, auth)
  | _ => none

/-- Liveness of the allocation `i` of `s`, if registered (§9 ¶1, §17 ¶3). -/
def liveOf (s : Machine.State) (i : Nat) : Option Bool := (s.allocs i).map (·.live)

/-- The bytes returned by a raw read through `ac` (§20.2 ¶1): the accessed range of the allocation
of its provenance; empty when the provenance names no allocation. -/
def readVal (s : Machine.State) (ac : Machine.Access) : List Machine.AByte :=
  ((s.allocs ac.prov).map fun a => a.bytesAt (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len).getD []

/-- A raw read meeting the kernel read conditions and the decidable read obligation of the runs is
`ok` and returns `readVal` (§15, §20.1 ¶2, §20.2 ¶1; the static obligation of the runs is
`True`). -/
theorem readStep_of {s : Machine.State} {ac : Machine.Access}
    (h : Machine.CanRead s ac ∧ obR.dec s ac ()) :
    Machine.ReadStep obR ac () s (.ok (readVal s ac)) := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, -⟩ := h.1
  have e : readVal s ac = a.bytesAt (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len := by simp [readVal, ha]
  rw [e]
  exact .ok ha ⟨h.1, h.2, trivial⟩

/-- A translated library run of a list of operations, in order (§82.7). -/

  | st, [] => some st
  | st, lop :: lops => (lsstep k π st lop).bind fun st' => lsrun st' lops

end Runner

/-- Initial library and memory states of a translated library run (§47, §82;
`LSimRun.init`). -/
def linit (statics : Statics) (π : Params Unit) : LState × Machine.State :=
  (LState.init statics, minit π statics)

/-- Final library and memory states of the translated library run of `lops` (§82.7); the initial
states when a step is not `ok`. -/
def lfin (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
    [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
    [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
    (statics : Statics) (π : Params Unit) (lops : List LOp) : LState × Machine.State :=
  (lsrun k π (linit statics π) lops).getD (linit statics π)

/-- The kernel operation of a library operation, if any (Part XIV). -/
def kernelOf : LOp → Option KOp
  | .kernel op => some op
  | _ => none

/-- The places at the end of a library run, computed from its kernel operations without checks
(§82): `newArena`, `issue` and `reset` create no place (§76–§78). The layout parameter is fixed
once from them. -/
def placesOf (statics : Statics) (lops : List LOp) : List Place :=
  (kernelRun (S3.init statics) (lops.filterMap kernelOf)).P

section Sound

variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- A computed next library state is the `ok` step of the library operation (Part XIV, §58,
§76–§78). -/
theorem lnext_sound {L L' : LState} {lop : LOp} (h : lnext k L lop = some L') :
    LOpStep k lop L L' := by
  cases lop with
  | kernel op =>
    simp only [lnext] at h
    split at h
    · next hp => cases h; exact ⟨opStep_of_pre hp, rfl⟩
    · cases h
  | newArena others st i =>
    simp only [lnext] at h
    split at h
    · next hp => cases h; exact .ok hp
    · cases h
  | issue i r d =>
    have hs := lstep_sound (k := k) L (.issue i r d)
    simp only [lnext] at h
    split at h
    · next L₁ he => cases h; rw [he] at hs; exact hs
    · cases h
  | reset i =>
    have hs := lstep_sound (k := k) L (.reset i)
    simp only [lnext] at h
    split at h
    · next L₁ he => cases h; rw [he] at hs; exact hs
    · cases h

/-- A successful translated library run extends a library simulation run (§82.7). -/
theorem lsrun_sound {statics : Statics} {π : Params Unit} :
    ∀ (lops : List LOp) (st st' : LState × Machine.State),
      LSimRun k (· = ·) obR obW statics π st.1 st.2 → lsrun k π st lops = some st' →
      LSimRun k (· = ·) obR obW statics π st'.1 st'.2
  | [], st, st', h, he => by
    simp only [lsrun, Option.some.injEq] at he; subst he; exact h
  | lop :: lops, st, st', h, he => by
    simp only [lsrun] at he
    cases hs : lsstep k π st lop with
    | none => rw [hs] at he; cases he
    | some st₁ =>
      rw [hs] at he
      simp only [Option.bind_some] at he
      unfold lsstep at hs
      split at hs
      · next L' hn =>
        split at hs
        · next hc =>
          simp only [Option.some.injEq] at hs; subst hs
          exact lsrun_sound lops _ st' (.step h (wf3_of_check hc.1) (noDangling_of_check hc.2.1)
            (lnext_sound hn) hc.2.2) he
        · cases hs
      · cases hs

/-- A successful translated kernel run from `S3.init statics` is a kernel simulation run (§82
preamble). -/
theorem ksim {statics : Statics} {π : Params Unit} {ops : List KOp} (hi : InitOK statics π)
    (h : (srun k (· = ·) obR obW π (sinit statics π) ops).isSome = true) :
    SimRun k (· = ·) obR obW statics π (kfin k statics π ops).1 (kfin k statics π ops).2 :=
  srun_sound ops (sinit statics π) _ (.init hi.1 hi.2.1 hi.2.2) (some_getD _ h)

/-- A successful translated library run from `LState.init statics` is a library simulation run
(§82.7). -/
theorem lsim {statics : Statics} {π : Params Unit} {lops : List LOp} (hi : InitOK statics π)
    (h : (lsrun k π (linit statics π) lops).isSome = true) :
    LSimRun k (· = ·) obR obW statics π (lfin k statics π lops).1 (lfin k statics π lops).2 :=
  lsrun_sound lops (linit statics π) _ (.init hi.1 hi.2.1 hi.2.2) (some_getD _ h)

/-- The raw operations realizing a kernel step from a state of a kernel simulation run are an
execution of `ok` raw steps (§82 preamble, `r6`), when the bounded invariant checks (§49, §54),
the preconditions of the step and its obligations hold. -/
theorem kexec {statics : Statics} {π : Params Unit} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {op : KOp}
    (hπ : ParamsOK (· = ·) π) (h : SimRun k (· = ·) obR obW statics π s3 s2)
    (hc : WF3Check s3 ∧ NoDanglingCheck s3 ∧ OpPre k op s3 ∧
      StepObl k (· = ·) obR obW π op s3 s2) :
    Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW (opsOf π op s3 s2) s2 (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) :=
  (r6 hπ (simulation hπ h).2.1 (wf3_of_check hc.1) (noDangling_of_check hc.2.1)
    (opStep_of_pre hc.2.2.1) hc.2.2.2).1

end Sound

/-! ## Raw operations and bytes read back (§9, §15–§17, §20) -/

/-- The allocation a raw operation reads, writes or deallocates (§15, §16, §17); none for a
creation. -/
def opAlloc {Ty : Type} : Machine.Op Ty → Option Nat
  | .read ac _ => some ac.prov
  | .write ac _ _ => some ac.prov
  | .dealloc i _ => some i
  | .alloc .. => none

/-- The kind of a raw operation (§20.1): 0 read, 1 write, 2 deallocation, 3 creation. -/
def opKind {Ty : Type} : Machine.Op Ty → Nat
  | .read .. => 0
  | .write .. => 1
  | .dealloc .. => 2
  | .alloc .. => 3

/-- The size of a raw creation (§9 ¶1, §9 ¶11). -/
def opSize {Ty : Type} : Machine.Op Ty → Option Nat
  | .alloc _ _ size _ _ => some size
  | _ => none

/-- The allocation and presented authority of a raw deallocation (§17). -/
def opDealloc {Ty : Type} : Machine.Op Ty → Option (Nat × Nat)
  | .dealloc i auth => some (i, auth)
  | _ => none

/-- Liveness of the allocation `i` of `s`, if registered (§9 ¶1, §17 ¶3). -/
def liveOf (s : Machine.State) (i : Nat) : Option Bool := (s.allocs i).map (·.live)

/-- The bytes returned by a raw read through `ac` (§20.2 ¶1): the accessed range of the allocation
of its provenance; empty when the provenance names no allocation. -/
def readVal (s : Machine.State) (ac : Machine.Access) : List Machine.AByte :=
  ((s.allocs ac.prov).map fun a => a.bytesAt (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len).getD []

/-- A raw read meeting the kernel read conditions and the decidable read obligation of the runs is
`ok` and returns `readVal` (§15, §20.1 ¶2, §20.2 ¶1; the static obligation of the runs is
`True`). -/
theorem readStep_of {s : Machine.State} {ac : Machine.Access}
    (h : Machine.CanRead s ac ∧ obR.dec s ac ()) :
    Machine.ReadStep obR ac () s (.ok (readVal s ac)) := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, -⟩ := h.1
  have e : readVal s ac = a.bytesAt (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len := by simp [readVal, ha]
  rw [e]
  exact .ok ha ⟨h.1, h.2, trivial⟩

end Ern.Corpus.MM23H

cd /Users/guygouri/Devlab/ernlang/ern/formal && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='Ern/Corpus/MM23H.lean'
s=open(p).read()
cases = r'''
/-! ## Reached states and their simulation (§82 preamble, §82.7) -/

/-- A reached state of a kernel run and the conclusions of `simulation` (§82 preamble, §57,
§9 ¶9): a translated run from `S3.init statics` reaches `s`; its memory state is reached from the
empty state by an execution of `ok` raw steps and is related to the kernel state by `Repr` (so the
layout satisfies `LayoutWF`); the kernel state is reachable. -/
def Sim (k : K) (statics : Statics) (π : Params Unit) (s : S3 × Machine.State) : Prop :=
  SimRun k (· = ·) obR obW statics π s.1 s.2 ∧
    (∃ os, Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW os Machine.State.empty s.2) ∧
    Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok s.1 s.2 ∧ Access.Reachable k statics s.1

/-- A reached state of a library run and the conclusions of `lsimulation` (§82.7, Part XIV): a
translated library run from `LState.init statics` reaches `st`; its memory state is reached from
the empty state by an execution of `ok` raw steps and is related to the kernel state by `Repr`;
the library state is library-reachable. -/
def LSim (k : K) (statics : Statics) (π : Params Unit) (st : LState × Machine.State) : Prop :=
  LSimRun k (· = ·) obR obW statics π st.1 st.2 ∧
    (∃ os, Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW os Machine.State.empty st.2) ∧
    Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok st.1.kern st.2 ∧ LReach k statics st.1

section Reached

variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- A successful translated kernel run reaches its final states, with the conclusions of
`simulation` (§82 preamble). -/
theorem sim {statics : Statics} {P : List Place} {z : List Nat} {ops : List KOp}
    (hi : InitOK statics (piOf P z))
    (h : (srun k (· = ·) obR obW (piOf P z) (sinit statics (piOf P z)) ops).isSome = true) :
    Sim k statics (piOf P z) (kfin k statics (piOf P z) ops) :=
  have hs := ksim hi h
  ⟨hs, simulation (piOf_ok P z) hs⟩

/-- A successful translated library run reaches its final states, with the conclusions of
`lsimulation` (§82.7). -/
theorem lsimOf {statics : Statics} {P : List Place} {z : List Nat} {lops : List LOp}
    (hi : InitOK statics (piOf P z))
    (h : (lsrun k (piOf P z) (linit statics (piOf P z)) lops).isSome = true) :
    LSim k statics (piOf P z) (lfin k statics (piOf P z) lops) :=
  have hs := lsim hi h
  ⟨hs, lsimulation (piOf_ok P z) hs⟩

end Reached

/-- Initialization state of the range of leaf `l` in `s`, if its allocation is registered (§10,
§15.3). -/
def initOf (s : Machine.State) (L : Layout) (l : Nat) : Option Bool :=
  (s.allocs (L l).alloc).map fun a => decide (a.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len)

/-! ## Run R1: owned storage, pinning, transfer, leak, exit (H03, H04, H07, H08, H09) -/

/-- Contract of R1 (§48, §75): `ExternalDone` for the storage leaf 3. -/
abbrev K1 : K := KT { done := [3] } false true

/-- Run R1 (§72, §67, §71, §74, §63, §75, §69, §73): frame 1 with the provider 0 and the values
`v` (1) and `w` (2), 0 and 1 written; storage 3 (one leaf) allocated from 0 for `v` (root
authority 3 held by `v`) and written; 3 pinned; `transfer(v, w)`; 3 unpinned; `endUse(w)`;
exit. -/
def r1 : List KOp := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0] wv, .write 1 [1] wv, .alloc 0 1 [lf],
  .write 3 [3] wv, .pin 3, .transfer 1 2, .unpin 3, .endUse 2, .exit]

/-- Parameters of R1, fixed once from its final places (§82). -/
def π1 : Params Unit := piOf (kernelRun (S3.init []) r1).P []

/-- State of R1 after its first `n` steps (§82). -/
def s1 (n : Nat) : S3 × Machine.State := kfin K1 [] π1 (r1.take n)

/-- The raw operations realizing `transfer(v, w)` in R1 (§82, §63). -/
def t1 : List (Machine.Op Unit) := opsOf π1 (.transfer 1 2) (s1 6).1 (s1 6).2

/-- **MM23-H03** (material §3, class R). Transfer of a value whose owned storage is pinned.
Expected (material): no machine step on the storage, address unchanged. Obtained: the same.
After six steps of R1 (reached, `Sim`) the storage leaf 3 is pinned; `transfer(v, w)` is `ok`
(§63.5: storage merely owned by the source does not prevent it, §87); its raw operations are an
execution of `ok` steps (§82), none reads, writes or deallocates the allocation of 3, which is
live before and after them at the same address (§82.6, §74). No rejection, no twin. -/
theorem H03 : Sim K1 [] π1 (s1 6) ∧ (s1 6).1.pin 3 = true ∧
    TransferStep K1 1 2 (s1 6).1 (.ok (transferEff (s1 6).1 1 2)) ∧
    Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW t1 (s1 6).2 (run (s1 6).2 t1) ∧
    (∀ o ∈ t1, opAlloc o ≠ some (π1.L 3).alloc) ∧
    liveOf (s1 6).2 (π1.L 3).alloc = some true ∧
    liveOf (run (s1 6).2 t1) (π1.L 3).alloc = some true ∧
    leafAddr (run (s1 6).2 t1) π1.L 3 = leafAddr (s1 6).2 π1.L 3 :=
  have h := sim (by decide) (by decide)
  ⟨h, by decide, .ok (by decide), kexec (piOf_ok _ _) h.1 (by decide), by decide, by decide,
    by decide, by decide⟩

/-- **MM23-H04** (material §3, class R). Transfer of a value in place. Expected (material): a read
then a write of the bytes, provenance kept; the source `Moved` and unreadable, its bytes still
initialized. Obtained: the same. From the reached state of H03, the raw operations of
`transfer(v, w)` are a read of the range of `v` then a write of the range of `w` (§82, §63); after
them the range of `w` holds the bytes of `v`, value and provenance (§16 ¶2, §20.2 ¶1), and the
range of `v` is unchanged and initialized; in the kernel the leaf of `v` is `Moved` (§63 effect)
and every read of it is rejected (§66.1). Twin of the rejected read, the same run without the
transfer: the read of `v` is `ok`. -/
theorem H04 : Sim K1 [] π1 (s1 6) ∧ t1.map opKind = [0, 1] ∧
    t1.map opAlloc = [some (π1.L 1).alloc, some (π1.L 2).alloc] ∧
    (∀ i < 8, bytesOf (run (s1 6).2 t1) π1.L 2 i = bytesOf (s1 6).2 π1.L 1 i) ∧
    (∀ i < 8, bytesOf (run (s1 6).2 t1) π1.L 1 i = bytesOf (s1 6).2 π1.L 1 i) ∧
    initOf (run (s1 6).2 t1) π1.L 1 = some true ∧
    (transferEff (s1 6).1 1 2).I 1 = .moved ∧
    (∀ a, Read3Step a [1] (transferEff (s1 6).1 1 2) .reject) ∧
    Read3Step 1 [1] (s1 6).1 (.ok (s1 6).1) :=
  ⟨sim (by decide) (by decide), by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    fun _ => .reject fun hp => absurd (hp.init 1 (List.mem_singleton_self _)) (by decide),
    .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- **MM23-H08** (material §3, class R). `endUse` of a value whose owned storage is not freed.
Expected (material): no machine step; the allocation stays live (a leak). Obtained: the same.
After eight steps of R1 (reached), `endUse(w)` is `ok` and realized by no raw operation (§82.5,
§69 effect "does not automatically trigger physical deallocation"); in the kernel the storage 3
is dead and unusable, in the machine its allocation is live, and still live at the end of R1. -/
theorem H08 : Sim K1 [] π1 (s1 8) ∧ Sim K1 [] π1 (s1 10) ∧
    EndUseStep K1 2 (s1 8).1 (.ok (endUseEff (s1 8).1 2)) ∧
    opsOf π1 (.endUse 2) (s1 8).1 (s1 8).2 = [] ∧
    (endUseEff (s1 8).1 2).dead 3 = true ∧ ¬ (endUseEff (s1 8).1 2).Usable 3 ∧
    liveOf (s1 8).2 (π1.L 3).alloc = some true ∧ liveOf (s1 10).2 (π1.L 3).alloc = some true :=
  ⟨sim (by decide) (by decide), sim (by decide) (by decide), .ok (by decide), rfl, by decide,
    by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-- The raw operations realizing the exit of frame 1 in R1 (§82, §73). -/
def x1 : List (Machine.Op Unit) := opsOf π1 .exit (s1 9).1 (s1 9).2

/-- **MM23-H09** (material §3, class R). Frame exit. Expected (material): one deallocation per
automatic allocation, none for the owned storage. Obtained: the same for the realization of the
reference (`exitOps`): after nine steps of R1 (reached), the exit is realized by one `ok`
deallocation of the allocation of each root local 0, 1, 2 of the frame with its recorded token
(§17, §82.5), dead afterwards, and none for the storage 3, live afterwards. **Source gap (open
obligation)**: spec v0 does not require the first half: §9 ¶2 ("storage with static or automatic
duration, whose particular rules will be defined later") and §73 ("Exiting does not entail
automatic physical deallocation of all dead places") leave the deallocation of automatic storage
at exit undetermined; it is a choice of the realization, not a spec v0 guarantee. -/
theorem H09 : Sim K1 [] π1 (s1 9) ∧ Sim K1 [] π1 (s1 10) ∧
    x1.map opDealloc = [some ((π1.L 0).alloc, 100), some ((π1.L 1).alloc, 101),
      some ((π1.L 2).alloc, 102)] ∧
    Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW x1 (s1 9).2 (run (s1 9).2 x1) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ [0, 1, 2], liveOf (run (s1 9).2 x1) (π1.L r).alloc = some false) ∧
    liveOf (run (s1 9).2 x1) (π1.L 3).alloc = some true :=
  have h := sim (by decide) (by decide)
  ⟨h, sim (by decide) (by decide), by decide, kexec (piOf_ok _ _) h.1 (by decide), by decide,
    by decide⟩
'''
s=s.replace("\nend Ern.Corpus.MM23H\n", cases+"\nend Ern.Corpus.MM23H\n")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

/-! ## Run R3: statics, read, `writeShared`, free, exit (H05, H10, H11, H12) -/

/-- Contract of R3 (§48): the leaf 3 `SharedMutable`; the storage 4 deallocable with the authority
104. -/

/-- One static leaf, `Init` (§47). -/

/-- Run R3 (§66, §72, §67, §60, §68, §71, §70, §73): the base frame reads the static 0; frame 1
with the provider 1, `x` (2) and the `SharedMutable` leaf 3, 1 and 2 written; 4, `Observe` on 3,
writes it by `writeShared`; storage 4 allocated from 1 for `x`, then freed with the authority 104;
exit. -/
def r3 : List KOp := [.read 0 [0], .enter [] [lf, lf, lf], .write 1 [1] wv, .write 2 [2] wv,
  .derive 3 [3] .observe, .writeShared 4 [3] wv, .alloc 1 2 [lf], .free 4 104, .exit]

4	/-!
5	# Corpus MM23-H: refinement (test module)
6	
7	The cases of corpus MM23-H of the Jalon 3 material (`ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md`, §3; non-normative
8	design material), replayed on the reference refinement of
9	`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md` (§82, Part XIV). This is a test module: no model or
10	library module imports it.
11	
12	Each case is a run from the initial state (§47) translated into the elementary memory machine with
13	the contract, the deallocation compatibility (equality of tokens), the read and write obligations
14	and the parameters fixed once for the run (§20.3 ¶3, §82): the test layout `piOf` of
15	`Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement.Runs` (each root place in its own allocation, each leaf 8 bytes at 8
16	times its rank, `LayoutWF` established by `Repr`), the placement `topPlacement`, the tokens
17	`100 + r`, the 8-byte reference encoding `pe8`. Runs of kernel operations only are kernel
18	simulation runs (`SimRun`, built by `srun`, conclusions by `simulation`); runs with an arena are
19	library simulation runs (`LSimRun`, built by the runner `lsrun` below, conclusions by
20	`lsimulation`), in which `issue` is the derived library operation (`split` then `store`) and
21	`reset` the derived reset (`derive` then `release`). The reached states are those of these runs
22	(material §0, rule 3). The obtained result is stated with the kernel relation of the step under
23	test, the machine relations of its realized raw operations (`ReadStep`, `WriteStep`,
24	`DeallocStep`, `Exec`) and the bytes read back, all decided by `decide`.
25	
26	Each docstring gives the expected verdict of the material, the obtained one, the class (material
27	§0, rule 5: `R` refinement) and the positive twin of each rejection or `fail` (rule 2). A case
28	whose obtained verdict differs from its expected one, or whose expected verdict has no spec v0
29	source, is kept with its expected verdict and classified; no case is corrected.
30	
31	Address rules of references (decisions of the brief, recorded for §82.3 in `Refinement.ptrAddr`):
32	an empty region has the base of the allocation of its effective anchor, with that allocation as
33	provenance; a nonempty region has the lowest address among its leaves of nonzero size; the
34	destination leaf has the size of a reference (`pe8.size = 8`).
35	
36	Not encoded (classified, material §3 and §6):
37	* MM23-H14, a raw pointer formed before a call and used during the call on the footprint of a
38	  `Modify` parameter: undefined behavior that no safe program constructs; class spec 3 (strong
39	  protection of parameters during the invocation, §72 last paragraph, §81) with the boundary of
40	  §19 (reconstruction of accesses from raw addresses).
41	* MM23-H17, a reference stored into a leaf of zero size: a conditional obligation of specs 4 and
42	  11 (a reference occupies a leaf of pointer size), not a guarantee of the refinement; class
43	  specs 4 and 11 (§81, §82.3 "a single logical leaf with an appropriate representation"). The
44	  pointer-size rule is a hypothesis of `Refinement.pointer_sound_store`.
45	-/

# Report — corpus-mm23h (brief obligation 7, corpus MM23-H)

File (new, untracked, nothing committed, no other file touched):
- `formal/Ern/Corpus/MM23H.lean` (module `Ern.Corpus.MM23H`, 813 lines; imports `Ern.Corpus.Runner`
  and `Ern.MemoryModel.RefinementArena`). Test module: no model or library module imports it.

## Status

- `lake build Ern.Corpus.MM23H`: success (about 5 s). `lake env lean` on the file prints nothing (no warning).
- `axcheck.sh Ern.Corpus.MM23H`: 139 constants, 52 theorems, `outside propext, Quot.sound: #[]`
  (so no `Classical.choice`).
- No `sorry/admit/native_decide/axiom/noncomputable/set_option`. Plain `decide` everywhere
  (`decide +kernel` was not needed). No line over 100 characters. Every
  `def/theorem/abbrev/instance` has an English docstring with a § citation (checked by script).
- Sanity check (scratch file, not kept): `decide` rejects false variants, e.g. "H16 decodes to the
  head leaf 5", "read through block 5 rejected before the end of the block", "static allocation
  dead at the end of R3".
- The whole-project `lake build` was not run, because other agents are writing files in
  `formal/Ern/Corpus/` at the same time.

## Spec passages used (by location)

§9 (¶1–¶3, ¶11), §10 ¶4–¶5, §15, §16 ¶2, §17, §19, §20.1–§20.3, §23, §46, §47, §58, §60, §61,
§63 (incl. §63.5), §65, §66, §67, §68, §69, §70, §71 (incl. §71.1), §72, §73, §74, §75, §76, §77,
§78 (incl. effect), §80, §81, §82 preamble, §82.1–§82.7, §86, §87.

## What the module contains

Runner (test code, with soundness proofs):
- `KT d dd sat`: a test contract given by `KD` lists. `DeclaredDisjoint` is leaf disjointness
  (§23) when `dd` holds; `Satisfiable` is the flag `sat`. It has 7 decidability instances, and
  `KT.ddSound` proves `DDSound` for it.
- Kernel runs use the existing `Refinement.srun`/`srun_sound`/`simulation` through
  `kfin`/`ksim`/`sim`. `kexec` turns `r6` into the `Exec` of the raw operations of one step.
- Library runs use a new executable runner: `lnext` (the kernel op by `OpPre`/`opEff3`, `newArena`
  by `NewArenaPre`, `issue`/`reset` by `Corpus.lstep`), then `lsstep`/`lsrun`/`lfin`.
  `lnext_sound` gives `LOpStep`, `lsrun_sound` gives `LSimRun`, and `lsim`/`lsimOf` give the
  conclusions of `lsimulation`. `placesOf` computes the final places for the layout.
- `Sim`/`LSim` bundle the reached-state evidence: `SimRun`/`LSimRun`, an `Exec` from
  `State.empty`, `Repr` (hence `LayoutWF`), and `Reachable`/`LReach`.
- Raw-op observers: `opAlloc`, `opKind`, `opSize`, `opDealloc`, `liveOf`, `initOf`. `readVal`
  gives the bytes a raw read returns, and `readStep_of` gives `ReadStep … (.ok (readVal …))`.
- Parameters: the test layout and parameters of `Refinement.Runs` (`piOf P z`, `topPlacement`,
  tokens `100 + r`, `pe8`, `obR`/`obW`, `C = (· = ·)`), fixed once per run from its final
  places.

Runs: R1 (kernel: owned storage, pin, transfer, leak, exit), R2 (library: arena, issue, write
through block, transfer, read, endUse, reset), R3 (kernel with a static: read, writeShared, alloc,
free, exit), R4 (kernel: split, leaf-disjointness contract), R5 (library: `issue []`, and `split
[[]]` then `store`), R6 (library: `issue [5, 4]`), R7 (kernel: alloc of zero size; the same
prefix under a contract where nothing is satisfiable).

## Case table

Class follows material §0 rule 5: MM23-H is `R`. H14 and H17 are classified by the material
(§3, §6) and by J3.

| id | source summary (material §3) | expected (material) | obtained (theorem) | class | twin | mismatch / cause |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| H01 | declared disjointness of two regions sharing a leaf | rejected by `DDSound` (leaf instantiation); declared regions ⇒ disjoint bytes | any `K` declaring `[1,2]`,`[2]` disjoint violates `DDSound`. Under the leaf-instantiated `K4` (`DDSound`), the `split 0 [[1,2],[2]]` is `reject` (§61.3). Every pair of declared regions of existing leaves is `ByteDisjoint` (`declaredDisjoint_bytes`, `LayoutWF` from `Repr`), `[1]`,`[2]` among them (`H01`) | R | `split 0 [[1],[2]]` `ok`, translated with `Repr` | none |

Block 5 is inactive and `read 5 [5]` is `reject` (§66.2). For every continuation `LPath`, no kernel step uses block 5 (`reset_no_access`, §82.7, §78, §86).
